pages.title: Bornean Orangutan
pages.text: The $(o)Bornean Orangutan$() ($(o)Pongo pygmaeus$()) is a great ape of the rainforests of Borneo, with a long, shaggy coat of red-brown hair and very long arms.$(br2)It spends most of its life in the trees, eating fruit, leaves and bark, and adult males grow large cheek pads and a throat sac for their long calls.$(br2)On the ground it walks on all fours, resting on its fists. It is the closest living relative of Gigantopithecus.
